description: Source code for bcm4908img utility functions, including parsing, creating, extracting, and managing boot filesystem images for BCM4908 devices.

methods.name: bcm4908img_info
methods.description: Displays information about a BCM4908 image file.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create
methods.description: Creates a new BCM4908 image file with specified data and padding options.

methods.name: bcm4908img_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified data segments (cferom, bootfs, rootfs, firmware) from a BCM4908 image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs
methods.description: Manages boot filesystem in BCM4908 image, including listing and renaming files.

methods.name: bcm4908img_open
methods.description: Opens a file or stdin for reading, with checks against TTY and pipe input.

methods.name: bcm4908img_close
methods.description: Closes a file pointer unless it is stdin.

methods.name: bcm4908img_parse
methods.description: Parses BCM4908 image to identify offsets, CRC, and validate integrity.

methods.name: bcm4908img_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for data buffer.

methods.name: bcm4908img_calc_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum of the image data starting from cferom or bootfs offset.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs_ls
methods.description: Lists files in the boot filesystem of the image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs_mv
methods.description: Renames a file within the boot filesystem of the image.
